items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: But they flew in from Italy they flew Gerry and Franca Mulligan in from Italy.

ctx.x: Life Magazine has re-staged the photo, and then done a new photo for 50 years from now I guess.

Well who knows? I mean already we’re thinking of people that should have been added and that it’s going to happen. The poor guy who did it. He’s been a basket case all summer long. First he wanted to line up all the people who were in the movie, who are still alive, who were gettable. And the only one that escaped his grasp was Sonny Rollins, who’s in Japan and couldn’t get out. But they flew in from Italy they flew Gerry and Franca Mulligan in from Italy.
